ownerSummaryFindings.finding: SEPA is a process (Trend Template, extra screens, historical leader profiles, relative prioritisation, manual single-stock review, fundamentals, technical structure, market environment, price/volume, liquidity, catalysts, analyst revisions, earnings/sales surprises), not a VCP detector
no universal GAAP-EPS-25% AND gate; turnarounds are a separate family
Power Play has its own exception characteristics
VCP numbers are typical shapes, not universal hard limits
3R is not universally mandatory; start exposure is adaptive, not a fixed 25/50/75/100 ladder
MA50 is contextual, not a blanket full sell; sell into strength is real; price confirmation of the fundamental thesis is central
not source-faithful: RS>0 as universal buy gate, every MA30 close break as full sell, missing support-based stops, mixing investor and trader paths
source-faithful: stage analysis, MA30, price/volume structure, RS as context, group strength, separate investor/trader/short paths
later precise box rules, 3-day boundary confirmation, buy stop above the box, stops at box structure
VU gaps: bottom-touch reset, extra VU thresholds, foreign TraderFox rules, foreign risk logic, missing adds
published core highly reproducible; VU is a long-only equity adaptation; missing adds, short skip, correlation limits, full S2, futures architecture
separate families Common Breakout, Episodic Pivot, Parabolic Short; low-of-day stop must not be replaced by an ADR clamp
only partially source-covered; later IBD teaching must not silently replace original O'Neil; full CAN SLIM needs new design scope

methods.name: Turtle System 1
methods.scope: VU_EQUITY_ADAPTATION (long-only translation of the published rules)
sourceBasis: scripts/supertrader/fidelity/canonical/turtle.json TUR-F-* (Original Turtle Trading Rules PDF, page-cited, HIGH)
methods.notes: Every entry, filter, failsafe, N, unit, add, stop, exit and limit rule has a page-cited primary source. Equity translation choices are declared deviations (TUR-E-*).

methods.name: Turtle System 2
methods.scope: VU_EQUITY_ADAPTATION (long-only translation of the published rules)
methods.notes: S2 = 55-day breakout, 20-day exit, no filter; shares N/unit/add/stop/limit rules with S1.

methods.name: Darvas later Q&A box rules
sourceBasis: scripts/supertrader/fidelity/canonical/darvas.json DAR-C-* (TIME 1959/1960 HIGH; book not read in repo, MEDIUM)
methods.notes: The precise later box rules (3-day confirmation, buy stop above box, box stops) are attested only by the owner summary; the book reconstruction with quotes/pages is not in the repository, so thresholds cannot be traced to a verifiable source id.

methods.name: Weinstein Stage 2 Investor
sourceBasis: scripts/supertrader/fidelity/canonical/weinstein.json (secondary sources with book quotes; book not read in repo)
methods.notes: Stage identification, resistance, support-based stops and group strength are chart judgments in the source; investor and trader paths differ.

methods.name: Weinstein Stage 2 Trader
methods.notes: Trader path (earlier entries, tighter stops) is a separate rule set; same judgment layer.

methods.name: Minervini SEPA / VCP
methods.scope: MACHINE_SCREEN -> RANKING -> MANUAL/AI REVIEW -> FINAL CANDIDATE
sourceBasis: scripts/supertrader/fidelity/canonical/minervini.json (book notes, interviews; books not read in repo)
methods.notes: Convergence of evidence and relative prioritisation with manual single-stock review; must not be one Boolean gate.

methods.name: Minervini Power Play
methods.notes: Own exception characteristics (owner summary); exact thresholds not verifiable in repository; entry needs pivot judgment.

methods.name: Kullamägi Common Breakout
methods.notes: Scan, prior move, orderly base and stop rules are documented by the trader; entry is the opening-range high on intraday bars and the stop the low of the entry day; base quality is a chart judgment.

methods.name: Kullamägi Episodic Pivot
methods.notes: Catalyst-driven gap with surprise; catalyst quality is a judgment; intraday entry.

methods.name: Kullamägi Parabolic Short
methods.notes: Short side with intraday triggers (opening range low, VWAP failure).

methods.name: Morales/Kacher Pocket Pivot
sourceBasis: owner summary lists it as an implementation candidate; no rulebook, quote or page in the repository
methods.notes: Volume rule and base/moving-average context must come from the book reconstruction artifact, which is absent.

methods.name: Morales/Kacher Buyable Gap-Up
sourceBasis: owner summary lists it as an implementation candidate; no rulebook, quote or page in the repository
methods.notes: Gap/volume thresholds and catalyst context are not verifiable in the repository.

methods.name: Raschke Holy Grail
sourceBasis: owner summary lists it as an implementation candidate; no rulebook, quote or page in the repository; not covered by the owner fidelity summary
methods.notes: Indicator thresholds would be source-less magic numbers without the reconstruction artifact.

methods.name: O'Neil CAN SLIM
methods.notes: Original O'Neil only partially covered; later IBD teaching must not replace it.

oldVuEngines.why: no adds, alphabetical instead of strength ranking, VU lifecycle (3 % proximity, 10-session expiry, 5-session cooldown) suppresses original signals, S1 filter ignores short breakouts, no unit heat, no notional account
oldVuEngines.repair: REBUILD_AS_SEPARATE_SOURCE_ENGINE (TURTLE_S1_SOURCE / TURTLE_S2_SOURCE); old engine kept as VU adaptation for A/B

oldVuEngines.why: VU/TraderFox numbers, momentum percentile gate, market light, foreign risk logic, bottom-touch reset, no adds (OSR-DAR-02)
oldVuEngines.repair: REBUILD_BOX_STATE_MACHINE_WHEN_SOURCE_ARTIFACT_AVAILABLE; local correction of thresholds is not possible without source ids

oldVuEngines.why: RS>0 universal gate, MA30 close break as full sell, no support stops, investor/trader mixed (OSR-WEI-01), foreign sizing
oldVuEngines.repair: REBUILD_AS_THREE_PATHS (investor, trader, stage-4 short) WITH MANUAL STAGE REVIEW

oldVuEngines.why: Trend Template + VU VCP as Boolean gate; universal EPS hard filters too strict; no SEPA review, no sell into strength (OSR-MIN-01..06)
oldVuEngines.repair: LOCAL_CORRECTION_POSSIBLE for the machine screen (remove universal hard gates, keep Trend Template as screen) + NEW MANUAL REVIEW LAYER

oldVuEngines.why: breakout core close to source but daily-bar entry and ADR clamp replace opening-range high and low-of-day stop (OSR-KK-01); EP and parabolic short missing
oldVuEngines.repair: LOCAL_CORRECTION for the daily screen; source-faithful entry needs intraday data; EP and PS are new engines
NONE (VU method, not measured against a trader source)
